settings.heading: Review
settings.text: Read the approved manual, warnings and verified limits before every use.

settings.heading: Prepare
settings.text: Inflate and fit only approved components exactly as instructed.

settings.heading: Check
settings.text: Inspect the float, valves, guards, batteries and surroundings before entering.

settings.heading: Use
settings.text: Enter safely, keep clear of hazards and remain with another responsible adult.

settings.heading: Dry
settings.text: Switch off, exit, inspect, dry fully and store as the manual directs.

settings.heading: A slower way around the pool.
settings.text: Use only the instructions supplied with the approved final product. This sequence is a high-level preview, not a substitute for the manual.
Adults aged 18 years and over only
Competent swimmers with another responsible adult present
Never use while impaired or near drains, covers, ropes or loose equipment
Switch off before handling and charge only when the product and charging area are fully dry

settings.heading: Relaxed pool time starts with clear limits.
settings.text: The planned Docked lounger is for competent adult swimmers in a calm, controlled swimming pool. It is not a life-saving device or personal flotation device.

settings.question: When will the Docked lounger be available?
settings.answer: The lounger remains Draft until supplier identity, the final sample, safety and compliance evidence, load testing, pricing, imagery, shipping and payment checks are complete. The current preview does not accept orders.

settings.question: Is the Docked lounger adults-only?
settings.answer: Yes. Docked intends to market the lounger for adults aged 18 years and over. This does not replace supervision, swimming ability, product testing or any applicable Australian product-safety obligation.

settings.question: Can I use the lounger at the beach or on a river?
settings.answer: No. Unless the exact final product is separately approved and documented, it is intended only for a calm, controlled swimming pool—not oceans, rivers, lakes, moving water, waves or currents.

settings.question: Is the lounger a life-saving device?
settings.answer: No. A pool lounger is not a life-saving device or personal flotation device and must never be relied on to prevent drowning.
